ic_name: MIPI DSI v1.01.00 (Display Serial Interface, MIPI Alliance)

calibration_categories.name: Eye diagram (HS pair)
calibration_categories.purpose: Inherited from D-PHY — verify HS driver / receiver / channel quality at the target data rate; jitter, eye height, eye width, common-mode.

calibration_categories.name: HS swing trim
calibration_categories.purpose: Inherited from D-PHY — adjust HS driver current to land in 100-200 mV differential swing across PVT.

calibration_categories.name: Lane delay-line trim
calibration_categories.purpose: Inherited from D-PHY — per-Lane programmable delay to bring inter-pair skew within bound; usually trained on Sync.

calibration_categories.name: Clock-Lane PLL lock
calibration_categories.purpose: Confirm host PLL hits target DDR frequency = data-rate / 2 within ppm tolerance.

calibration_categories.name: Host vs Peripheral LP clock ratio
calibration_categories.purpose: Verify host LP clock is within 67%..150% of peripheral LP clock frequency (§5.6.1); confirm peripheral implementer-declared nominal LP frequency + accuracy.

calibration_categories.name: T_INIT_MASTER vs t_POR + T_INIT_SLAVE + T_INTERNAL_DELAY
calibration_categories.purpose: Verify host's T_INIT_MASTER programmed long enough for peripheral (§5.7).

calibration_categories.name: EoTp enable/disable mechanism
calibration_categories.purpose: Verify implementation-specific means to enable / disable EoTp generation and detection for backward compatibility with DSI v1.0 peripherals (§8.8.2).

calibration_categories.name: ECC self-check
calibration_categories.purpose: Inject 1-bit / 2-bit errors into header; confirm correction + detection + Error Register bit 8 / bit 9 set; confirm packet drop on bit 9.

calibration_categories.name: Checksum self-check
calibration_categories.purpose: Inject CRC-16 mismatch into Long Packet payload; confirm receiver reports Error Register bit 10; confirm Annex B reference CRC outputs (gpcTestData0/1/2/3 → 0x0F87 / 0x1E0E / 0xE569 / 0x00F0).

calibration_categories.name: BTA timing
calibration_categories.purpose: Verify BTA completes within bounded time; if TA_TO timer is implemented, verify expiration triggers recovery.

calibration_categories.name: HRX_TO / HTX_TO / LTX-P_TO / LRX-H_TO
calibration_categories.purpose: Configure contention recovery timers; verify LRX-H_TO > LTX-P_TO; verify each timeout triggers appropriate recovery flow (Annex A Cases 1/2/3).

calibration_categories.name: TE wait window
calibration_categories.purpose: Verify host waits approximately one video frame period for TE response after BTA-without-command before re-acquiring bus.

calibration_categories.name: Set Maximum Return Packet Size
calibration_categories.purpose: Verify default value of 1 at power-on / reset; verify host's 0x37 command takes effect on subsequent read responses.

notes: MIPI DSI v1.01.00 inherits all PHY-level lab characterization from D-PHY v0.90.00 (eye, swing, skew, PLL). Above the PHY, DSI-specific calibration centers on (a) verifying T_INIT power-up timing, (b) EoTp enable/disable interoperability, (c) BTA + contention-recovery timers, (d) TE wait period, and (e) Set Maximum Return Packet Size default. Annex B of the spec provides four reference CRC-16 test vectors with expected outputs that are the canonical regression inputs for any DSI receiver's checksum verifier.
